title: $1,000 in a Cookie Jar for 30 Years #shorts
description:
Ben hid $1,000 in a cookie jar in November 1996. Every bill is still there, but at today's prices it only buys what $470 bought back then. His sister put the same $1,000 in the stock market (S&P 500 with dividends reinvested): today it's worth $16,368.
Watch the full story: Grandpa Gave 3 Kids $1,000. Who Won? https://youtu.be/o0-ZXEnRyDg

The characters are made up; the numbers are real. Data: FRED CPI-U (CPIAUCSL), Nov 1996 to the latest month; Yahoo Finance ^SP500TR, Nov 25 1996 to the latest close. Past returns don't guarantee future results. Education only, not financial advice.
#inflation #saving #investing
